notes.title: Version 22.2.5.1804 released
notes.content:
Bugfixes:
[olist]
[*] the demand need not be fulfilled by player (it can be avoided by pushing pass button);
[*] "Show left cards after finished round" option is affected by "Preview of taken cards" option;
[*] replay: situation when bomb is thrown besides own turn is incorrectly saved.
[/olist]
AI:
[olist]
[*] bugfixes:
    * do not beat right/next opponent who just finished, partner will lead;
    * do not beat single of partner with strongest single, even if I would finish in next move.
[/olist]

notes.title: Version 22.2.3.1782 released

tags.feature: replay: possibility to play multiplayer game from selected position;

tags.bug: sometimes after the round is finished left cards are shown only for a moment without confirmation;
sometimes bot plays cards right after the round is finished;
replay: sometimes score of round is incorrect (both teams do not sum to 100);
GUI: cards of left, top and right players are turned upside down (visible on back of cards);

tags.balance_change: fast hand: do not beat partner who has Dog with a bomb;
do not beat long partner's set when having another entry on hand;

tags.bug: start from weak card (not from Dragon!);
partner finished first, I will be last, taking points: sometimes it is performed with too strong cards;
